# Enzo Norese — Backend Developer & Cloud Architect

> Backend developer and cloud architect based in Santiago, Chile. Specialized in cloud infrastructure, serverless architectures, and AI integration. Go-to engineer (technical reference) on architecture decisions, with hands-on experience in recruitment systems, ERP migration, and AI model integration. Site available in English (/en) and Spanish (/es).

## About (English)

Enzo Norese is a Computer Engineer with an electronics background, specialized in backend development and cloud solutions architecture. At TeamWork Capacitación Ltda. (Santiago, Chile) he works as technical reference and solutions architect, designing and building high-impact systems for real business operations.

He leads two key initiatives: the Softland → Rex+ ERP migration (completed with zero data loss and zero downtime) and the "Digital 24/7 Recruiter" — an AI-powered mass-recruitment agent on Azure serverless, with a cascaded multi-model pipeline (Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini) able to process tens of thousands of applications during peak demand (e.g. Cyber Day).

His engineering philosophy — "Augmented Engineering" — treats AI tools as multipliers of technical capability, not replacements for sound engineering judgment.

## Sobre mí (Español)

Enzo Norese es Ingeniero en Informática con base en electrónica, especializado en desarrollo backend y arquitectura de soluciones cloud. En TeamWork Capacitación Ltda. (Santiago, Chile) se desempeña como referente técnico y arquitecto de soluciones, diseñando y construyendo sistemas de alto impacto para operaciones reales de negocio.

Lidera la migración ERP Softland → Rex+ (con cero pérdida de datos y cero downtime) y el "Reclutador Digital 24/7" — un agente de reclutamiento masivo con IA sobre Azure serverless, con un pipeline multi-modelo en cascada (Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini). Su filosofía es la "Ingeniería Aumentada": la IA como multiplicador de capacidad técnica, no como sustituto del criterio ingenieril.

## Stack / Tech

- Cloud: Microsoft Azure (Azure Functions, Service Bus, SignalR, Blob Storage, CosmosDB)
- Languages: TypeScript, Node.js, Python, C# / .NET Core
- Frontend: React, HTML, CSS, JavaScript
- Databases: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, CosmosDB, MongoDB, Redis
- DevOps: GitHub Actions, Docker, CI/CD
- Security: OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT
- AI: Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini (multi-model orchestration)
